answer: Let each new agent post a small bond and join as a vertex in a trust graph, where edges form only after it grades peers' work and is graded back. A ring of fake identities then shows up like an umber stain on the map: dense links among themselves, few to the honest core. Flow-based scoring treats that thin cut as a beacon, so rewards reaching the ring stay capped by its handful of real edges, no matter how many copies it spawns.
